status: preregistered before any Barcelona model fit

data_gate.meaning: Necessary engineering gate for a descriptive grouped experiment, not proof of statistical power or generalization. No confidence interval claim with fewer than eight test groups.

grouping: All stints from a declared recording folder remain together. Header dates must agree with catalogue dates. A-coded unresolved series and unknown/ambiguous capture identities are quarantined. Overlapping same-participant acquisition intervals are merged or quarantined, never split.
split: Sort complete independent groups by supported recording date, then deterministic group ID for same-date distinct acquisitions. Train approximately 60%, reserving at least three complete groups each for validation and final test. Same-date boundary groups remain in one partition to avoid unsupported intra-day ordering. Freeze membership and corpus identity before fitting.
features: All thirteen existing causal v0.6 FEATURES, unchanged. Fixed before split/fitting; no Barcelona feature selection.
preprocessing: Existing make_models pipelines: training-only median imputation; training-only StandardScaler for Ridge/SVR; no held-out fitting.
test_policy: Only the validation-selected model is evaluated on the final reserved groups, after selection and development experiments are frozen. No test-driven cleaning, feature changes, tuning or re-ranking. Persist final results; repeat commands verify/reuse them without another test evaluation.
baseline_history: Only complete comparable training laps whose verified completion precedes the evaluated lap. Same-date distinct groups with unknown absolute acquisition order are unavailable to each other's history; no held-out target updates.
learning_curve: If at least six training groups exist, fit the same fixed three configurations on chronological prefixes of approximately half, three quarters and all training groups. Use the same untouched validation groups and training-only preprocessing/history each time. Report train/validation/group/slow-band errors, never final-test scores. No hyperparameter variants.
fast_slow_bands: Q25/Q75 of full training-lap targets, fixed before final test. No exclusion based on model error.
uncertainty: Physical groups are experimental units. With fewer than eight test groups, publish group errors/ranges and explicitly withhold inferential confidence intervals.
failure_policy: If any data gate fails, preserve audit/subset/acquisition/domain code and show the failure in the primary ML UI. Do not fit or report fabricated model metrics; final generalization remains unresolved.
